newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk to get over half Conrail routes - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk to get over half Conrail routes - WSJ.

text.p: Norfolk Southern is expected to acquire over half of Conrail Inc's routes and spend at least $700 million more than originally thought in splitting Conrail and CSX Corp, the Wall Street Journal said in Thursday's electronic edition.

Railroads CSX and Conrail on March 7 agreed to a $10.3 billion revised merger agreement which enabled CSX to negotiate a division of Conrail with Norfolk Southern. Norfolk has pursued a hostile takeover battle for Conrail.
Under the breakup terms, Norfolk Southern was seen getting at least 57 percent of Conrail's northeastern U.S. rail system, the paper said, citing people familiar with the matter.
Norfolk would spend about $5.9 billion acquiring its Conrail share and CSX would spend about $4.4 billion, the paper said. None of the companies was immediately available for comment.
The paper said a breakup was expected to be announced within a week.
